description:
Generate a complete build prompt for a coding agent: ordered screens with notes, observed
transitions, full-resolution image URLs, the measured design guide, and an implementation
checklist. This is the same prompt as the "Use in agent" button on the site.

Reference IDs: use `{product}-onboarding` for a product's signup flow, `{product}-collection`
for all their screens, or any single screen id (like `linear-marketing-pricing`).

Use this when you want to build UI that follows a real product's patterns. The prompt includes
everything an agent needs: screenshots to reference, design tokens to match, and implementation
steps to follow.

goal.description: What you want to build. Goes at the top of the prompt.

includeDesign.description: Include the observed design guide. Set false to use your project's own design system.

screens.description: Comma-separated screen ids to keep. Omit to include every screen in the reference.

stack.description: Preferred stack, e.g. Next.js and Tailwind.

name: build_handoff

prompt.description: Markdown prompt to follow or paste into an agent.

title: Build an agent handoff prompt
